title: Quadratic distances in even dimensions over prime fields
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $m\geq1$ be an integer, and let $Q$ be a nondegenerate quadratic form on $\mathbb F_p^{2m}$. For a nonempty set $E\subseteq\mathbb F_p^{2m}$, write $Δ_Q(E)=\{Q(x-y):x,y\in E\}$. We prove that, whenever $|E|>p^m$, \[ |Δ_Q(E)|\gg \min\left\{\frac{p}{L_E},\, \frac{|E|}{p^{m-1}L_E^2}\right\}, \qquad L_E=\log\left(2+\frac{p^{m+1}}{|E|}\right), \] with an absolute implied constant independent of $p$, $m$ and $Q$.
